title: Japanese government funded: AI chat platform with Fujitsu

ms.promise:
A: Product with the following integrated features:
・A chat community included within the product, with one or more private channels only accessible with Cardano-based NFTs or invite codes.
・Integration of AI into the product to measure enthusiasm scores based on chats/messages in the community.
・A dashboard or a UI window that displays the enthusiasm scores generated by the AI.
・A 3D environment integrated with the product.
・Functionality where users can send paid messages to Content IP (i.e. an artist, athlete, or enterprise) with money, and receive NFTs in response.

(In response to the Catalyst Team reviewer's comment: This is one output: "A Product." The list above describes the required feature set.)

*********(Below are clarifications)************
*Clarification:
In response to the Catalyst Team reviewer’s questions, we would like to offer the following clarifications:
1. Fujitsu’s role and dependencies
As described in our proposal, Fujitsu’s role in the overall project (not tied specifically to Milestone 1) is to provide access to athlete(s) and their mocap-AI technology, enabling Anifie to generate motion-based NFTs using Fujitsu's mocap-AI on the athletes provided by Fujit
ms.criteria:
A: The Product meets the following criteria:
・The product platform includes all features listed in Output A.
・Functionality is tested by a quality assurance member.
・The project manager (specifically, Yohei Iwasaki in this case) approves the test result from the quality assurance member with comment that the product is ready to launch.
・The product is launched to the public.

(In response to the Catalyst Team reviewer's comment: This is the acceptance criteria for the Product – only one Output.)
ms.report:

Above is what we submitted originally. Three of the reviewers approved. One reviewer disapproved with the following comment "public URL (PWA/AppClip) and a documented QA checklist, directly satisfying the "Product Launch". However a video or access to the features in the Output would help reviewers to access the deliverable wholistic". 
However:
・The video is not required in the "Evidence". 
・The "access to the features" was provided in our original submission. 

The link to the video is below. However, in the future milestones, we do not wish to be required additional milestones that were not agreed. All of us discussed and agreed on the milestones a few months ago. Requiring an additional milestone after the agreement was reached does not seem fair.
